Hotspots and doors#

Make a scene respond. Pin a price card to a room, let buyers open the front door, switch the lights, or empty the furniture, all without leaving the link.

Add hotspots#

  1. Open your scene while signed in and add ?interact=edit to the link.
  2. Click a surface and choose Add hotspot. A pin appears there.
  3. Fill the card: title, text, image, a price tag, an icon style, and an optional call-to-action button, such as Book a visit (a link, a tel:, mailto: or WhatsApp link). Fly there moves the camera to a view you pick.
  4. Save. Everyone who opens the scene sees the pins.

Make objects interactive#

Click a door, a sofa or a lamp in edit mode and choose what it does:

ActionResult
DoorOpens and closes by swinging on a hinge or sliding. Verse guesses the hinge from the edge of the door. An open door frees the floor for walking.
Show / hideToggle a part of the scene.
FinishSwitch a material, such as the flooring.
LightTurn a lamp on and off.
AnimationPlay a clip from the file.

Choose a trigger: click or tap, walking near it (with a radius), or a stop in a guided tour. Big streamed scenes work too: doors really swing in both the high-end and the compatibility renderers.

Scene toggles#

Switch on any of: Day / Evening / Night, Empty room (hides the furniture group) and Measure.

Limits#

Up to 64 hotspots and 64 interactive objects per scene, 64 KB in all. Links must be https:, http:, tel:, mailto:, whatsapp: or a path on the same site; images must be https: or the same site.

See what visitors do#

Hotspot opens, button clicks and objects used appear in the scene's analytics. For developers the data is GET and PUT /v1/scenes/<id>/interact; see the API reference.
